footer.about: Cook's Heating and Cooling repairs, installs and maintains air conditioners and furnaces for homes and businesses in Wichita, Kansas, from our office at 2215 S West St.

why: The top of your homepage has no headline. The only thing there is your logo, and the name in your browser tab is “Home - Cook's Heating and Cooling.” Nothing tells Google, or a homeowner searching on a hot day, you are an HVAC company in Wichita.

Your customers already make your case. Brian F.: “They come out ASAP when your Air is not working and fix it right.” None of it is on your site, so a visitor who does not know you has only your word for it.
So our demo says HVAC company in Wichita, KS at the very top, gives AC repair and furnace repair a page each, and sets your customers' words beside the work they describe.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the HVAC Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one demo page: what costs you calls, and the fix.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn where you work.
problems: The top of your homepage has no headline, so Google can't tell you're an HVAC company in Wichita.
At the very bottom of every page your number is plain text, so a visitor has to type it in.
Your services page names Trane, Goodman and Carrier as top brands. We couldn't confirm that on the manufacturers' dealer finders.
fixes: A headline that says HVAC company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Your number is one tap at the top and the bottom of every page.
Brand lines wait until we confirm them together.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: AC Repair
cards.why: Where a hot homeowner decides whom to call.
problems: AC repair shares a page with installation, so “AC repair Wichita KS” has no page built for it.
The page carries no customer words, so the proof stays on Google.
fixes: A page for AC repair in Wichita, KS, covering what happens when you call.
Your customers' words beside each point they prove.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Furnace Repair
cards.why: Where a cold homeowner decides whom to call.
problems: Furnace repair shares a page with heating installation, so the urgent call is buried.
No reviews appear anywhere on that page.
fixes: A page for furnace repair in Wichita, KS, with repair and replacement kept apart.
Reviews matched to what the furnace work involves.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a visitor decides to call.
problems: Your hours sit only at the bottom of the page, with no emergency hours beside your number.
Visitors see no email address; it is hidden in the page code.
fixes: Number, address and hours together, emergency hours included.
A short list of what to have ready when you call.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

onboardingQuestions: Who owns Cook's, and who is the second-generation family? One 2009 review says the company was bought out in 2008; the About page says family business.
What year was the company founded? (The site's copyright line says 2016.)
Which manufacturers are you authorized dealers for? Trane and Carrier did not list Cook's for ZIP 67213; we did not check Goodman, Lennox, Rheem or American Standard.
Kansas contractor licence number and liability insurance.
Saturday or after-10 PM service beyond the weekday 5 PM to 10 PM emergency window.
Maintenance plans: current prices and terms for Premium and the 5- and 10-year plans.
How much of the work is commercial?
Which email address should customers see? service@cookshvac.com is only in a hidden comment in the page code.
What does the KCAA logo in the footer mean?
Free estimates, financing and warranty terms: any you want shown?
Which towns beyond Wichita do you serve? Belle Plaine appears only in a customer review.
